title: Subsample BirdNET detections by species — birdnet_subsample
text: data data frame containing BirdNET output. n Integer. Total number detections subsample. data n fewer rows, rows returned. method Character. Subsampling method use. One : "even_stratified" Samples evenly across confidence score bins. Bins detections contribute , remainder shared among bins. "proportional_stratified" Samples across confidence score bins proportion number detections bin. "random" Simple random sample n detections. "top" n detections highest confidence. Defaults "even_stratified". bin_width Numeric. Width confidence score bins used stratified methods. Defaults 0.05. seed Integer NULL. given, subsample reproducible. random number generator state session left unchanged. save_to_file Logical. TRUE, saves output CSV file. Defaults FALSE. Automatically set TRUE file provided. file Character NULL. File path save output CSV. NULL save_to_file = TRUE, saves "subsampled_data.csv" working directory. quiet Logical. TRUE, suppresses status messages many detections returned whether kept data n rows. Defaults FALSE. #' @details Choosing method. "random" gives unbiased sample, suited estimating overall precision. "even_stratified" gives balanced coverage across confidence scores, suited relating precision score choosing threshold. "proportional_stratified" mirrors confidence distribution detections, dominated low-confidence detections. "top" useful confirming species present, biased estimating precision. Several species. Sampling done per species. subsample species separately, apply function species turn (see Examples).
